name: 摘要生成器（基于句子权重）

map.📖 查看「摘要生成器（基于句子权重） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Summary Generator (based on sentence weights) User Guide"
map.摘要按句子权重抽取：句子得分 = Σ 该句实词词频（可除以词总数归一）+ 位置加: Summaries are extracted by sentence weight: sentence score = Σ word frequency of its content words (optionally normalized by word count) + positional weighting (first paragraph ×1.5, containing title words ×1.2) − length penalty; the top k sentences are taken in descending score order (k set by summary length or sentence count) and reordered as they appear in the original text; compression ratio = summary words ÷ original words × 100%.
map.📚 深度解析：基于句子权重（位置、长度、关键词）抽取关键句生成文本摘要，辅助快速: 📚 In-depth: extracts key sentences by their weights (position, length, keywords) to build a text summary, helping you read faster.
map.句权计算：评估各句重要度。: Sentence weights: evaluates how important each sentence is.
map.摘要抽取：取高分句组成摘要。: Summary extraction: the highest-scoring sentences form the summary.
map.可调长度：控制摘要句数。: Adjustable length: control how many sentences go in.
map.示例：千字文抽取 3 句关键句作摘要。: Example: three key sentences are extracted as the summary of a thousand-character article.
map.按位置与词频近似评分，非语义理解。: It approximates importance from position and word frequency rather than understanding meaning.
map.为粗略提取，重要句可能遗漏，需人工核对。: It is a rough extraction that can miss important sentences, so verify the result yourself.
map.长文速览与笔记辅助。: Skimming long texts and supporting note-taking.

map.摘要按句子权重抽取：句子得分 = 该句实词平均词频（各实词在全篇出现次数之和 ÷: Summary extraction by sentence weight: sentence score = average word frequency of content words in the sentence (sum of occurrences of each content word in the whole text ÷ number of content words) + position weighting (first sentence ×1.5) − length penalty (character count ÷ 200); take the top k sentences by descending score, then reorder them in the original order; compression ratio = summary characters ÷ original characters × 100%.
